result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages pair a plain system sans with one monospace face and show no external dependencies. B also sets the ETA times in monospace and puts dock doors and statuses in outlined badges with shape cues, so times are easier to compare at a glance than A's sans-set ETAs. B's footer legend doesn't quite match its icons (En Route shows a square), but that is minor. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both are clean dark utility tables that pair a system sans with a monospace face for IDs and dock doors, and both keep status readable with color plus a shape. A also sets ETAs in monospace, so times are easier to compare across rows, and its pill badges stand out more from across a room. A has small flaws: the dock-door header switches to the monospace face, and the footer legend gives en route a circle when the table shows a square. B's ETAs are in the sans, and they still look aligned.
